description: A digital temperature sensor using the 1-Wire protocol — multiple units can share a single data line, each identified by its own `deviceID` attribute.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, DQ is the 1-Wire data line — a genuine shared bus when multiple sensors are chained onto the same DQ pin. NOTE: this project's protocol-bus protection only recognizes I2C (SDA/SCL) and SPI (SCK/MOSI/MISO/DO/DI) leg names — a shared 1-Wire DQ line is currently NOT protected the way I2C/SPI buses are, so a deviation on one sensor's DQ in a multi-sensor 1-Wire chain could silently desync it from the others. Known, unfixed gap — flag before trusting a multi-DS18B20 lesson's substitution behavior.
